_note: Interest on a loan for a house: "An assessee, being an individual not eligible to claim deduction under section 130, shall be allowed a deduction of interest payable on loan taken by him from any financial institution for the purpose of acquisition of a residential house property, subject to a maximum limit of ₹150000" (s.131(1), p.166); "(a) the loan has been sanctioned … during the period beginning on the 1st April, 2019 and ending on the 31st March, 2022; (b) the stamp duty value of residential house property does not exceed forty-five lakh rupees; and (c) the assessee does not own any residential house property on the date of sanction of loan" (s.131(2)). ChapterEightNode tries DED-HOUSE-LOAN-EARLIER first. The same interest is not deductible under any other provision for the same or any other tax year (s.131(3)) — house-property interest under s.22(1)(b) must leave it out (W-078). rulebook DED-80EEA-001, DED-80EX-001. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26; the 1961 counterpart, s.80EEA, is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d4). D-139. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80EEA as inserted by F(No.2)A 2019 s.25 (p.16): an individual "not eligible to claim deduction under section 80EE", interest payable on a loan for acquiring a residential house property, "(2) … shall not exceed one lakh and fifty thousand rupees"; (3)(i) sanctioned from 1-4-2019 to 31-3-2020, extended to 2021 by FA 2020 s.32 (p.26) and to "2022" by FA 2021 s.27 (p.32); (ii) "the stamp duty value of residential house property does not exceed forty-five lakh rupees"; (iii) no residential house property owned on the date of sanction — the same row. sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md M3, M5, M7. D-147. In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION, whose basis REG-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (S2 s.202(2)(a); 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i)) every explanation cites (D-166).
